title: Phase 1 checkpoint plan · prototipo de carreras off-road

scope.prototype: one off-road track, a few cars, accessible keyboard/controller driving, bots, and basic network play
scope.network: Unity Netcode for GameObjects with Relay/Lobby

assumptions: The checkout is a bootstrap repository with no Unity project, source code, assets, commits, or configured CI.
A Unity LTS version and package versions will be selected during project bootstrap; Unity Hub/editor may be unavailable in this environment.
Relay/Lobby credentials, project ID, test devices, and internet access will be supplied outside this repository before network validation.
Offline bots remain the fallback when a network session cannot be created.
UI validation is deferred because this repository contains no runnable Unity application; checkpoints use ui=n/a.
Verification commands are limited to repository and artifact checks until Unity tooling exists.

checkpoints.name: Bootstrap Unity project and package baseline
checkpoints.objective: Create the Unity PC project structure, lock the Unity/package baseline, and document required external services without implementing gameplay.
deliverables: README with editor and service prerequisites

gates.entry: Approved PRD and brainstorm are present; repository is otherwise empty.
gates.exit: Project opens in the selected Unity LTS version, packages resolve, and required prerequisites are documented.

checkpoints.name: Build the offline driving slice
checkpoints.objective: Implement one third-person off-road track, a few drivable cars, accessible keyboard/controller input, assisted steering/recovery, collision slowdown/damage feedback, and a 3–5 minute race loop.

gates.entry: Bootstrap project opens and package baseline is reproducible.
gates.exit: A player can start, drive, recover, finish a race in 3–5 minutes, and receive a reward/unlock; bots fill empty slots.
gates.note: The Unity command is expected to remain unavailable until the editor is installed; record that as blocked rather than claiming a pass.

checkpoints.name: Add basic Relay/Lobby network play
checkpoints.objective: Separate race logic from transport and add host/join flow with Netcode for GameObjects, Lobby, and Relay while preserving offline fallback.

gates.entry: Offline race slice is playable and deterministic enough for comparison.
gates.exit: Two PC instances can host/join a race through Relay/Lobby, synchronize essential race state, and return to offline bots on failure.
gates.note: Live network verification requires Unity, a configured Unity Gaming Services project, credentials, and two reachable instances.

checkpoints.name: Validate Phase 1 prototype and hand off
checkpoints.objective: Run available checks, capture known limitations, and confirm the approved feature's core acceptance scenarios without adding scope.

gates.entry: Offline and network slices have completed their preceding gates or have explicit blockers.
gates.exit: Repository checks pass, playable scenarios are evidenced where tooling exists, and unresolved external prerequisites are listed.
verify: Manual Unity PC build validation: menu → lobby → selection → race → results; record blocked if Unity/services are unavailable
gates.note: Do not mark gameplay or network acceptance passed from this empty checkout alone.
